rationale: B better preserves the reactive system's stable-state semantics by recomputing the entire affected graph before invoking any callbacks, so callbacks cannot observe downstream cells in a stale intermediate state. Its postorder collection and reversed recomputation also provide a clear topological update sequence. A has a cleaner shared Cell abstraction, but invokes callbacks during recomputation, before the whole graph has necessarily stabilized, and retains the caller's mutable inputs collection rather than copying it.
